answers.why: The returned exiles seek the LORD as the God of their nation Israel.
The God of Israel is worshipped in the temple the returned community is rebuilding.
The LORD God of Israel gave the law of Moses to the nation.
Ezra prepares to teach statutes and judgments among the people of Israel.
The LORD's commandments and statutes apply to the nation Israel.
Ezra gathers chief men from the Israelite community to travel with him.
The genealogy names Levi as Mahli's ancestor and Israel's son.
Israel is named as Levi's father in the genealogy.
All Israel present joins the king and his officials in making offerings.
Israel has family heads at Jerusalem before whom the offerings will be weighed.
The returned exiles offer sacrifices to the God of their nation Israel.
Twelve bullocks are offered on behalf of all Israel.
